scope: Both complete original PDFs, the whole accepted common paper and both whole accepted applications. Executable programs/data remain a separate complete file inventory; no software-inclusive factor.

unit_definitions.characters_without_whitespace: sum(not c.isspace() for c in text)

source_boundary: Every physical page, title/abstract/body/tables/footnotes/references retained; no body-only cuts. Exclude only exact identified running headers/page-number furniture and symmetrically excluded executable listings. Publisher bibliographic/copyright/author footnotes remain.
extraction: pypdf 6.13.0 literal page.extract_text(), pages joined by one newline. Visitor/event reconciliation may annotate generated whitespace but must not change raw returned extraction.
calibration: Fresh actual font dictionary, effective Encoding and encoded event plus actual outline evidence. Includes control, private-use, printable aliases and visible glyphs decoded as whitespace; preserve generated whitespace, printed hyphens and mathematical source errors. No BaseFont-only cache, OCR, rewriting or prior-source map transplant.

symmetric_program_boundary.manuscripts: Exclude actual executable/pseudocode listings on both sides under exact occurrence masks. Retain mathematical definitions/equations/algorithm/proof prose. Complete all five PDF listing screens before final freeze.
symmetric_program_boundary.required_programs: Whole mathematical certificate implementations and all mandatory input/record data remain explicit premises outside manuscript length; no relabeling as optional.
symmetric_program_boundary.optional_validation: Whole optional validations separately inventoried and excluded on both sides.
symmetric_program_boundary.raw_vs_printed: Alternative representations, never added to each other. No software-inclusive factor without matched original software.

whole_topic: The full common paper is paid once with both complete current applications; old migrated local notes are provenance, not unpaid current prose premises. Required whole programs/data are separately inventoried and must be acquired for each conditional proof use. No factor is computed by this input packet.
